title: project real installable payload object descriptor from current build artifacts

criteria: The projection script produces a descriptor for a real local payload byte file.
The descriptor binds source bytes, size, SHA-256, build manifest, release provenance, signed metadata projection, revocation snapshot, compatibility, rollback baseline, and support/recovery metadata.
The result records external object URI, public signature ingestion, installer VM smoke, and declared/current drift blockers while keeping install_allowed=false.
The task preserves non-GA status and moves the next task to RC8-011 public signature artifact ingestion.
